title: Grandfather's chickens and the family that could not eat them
summary: Story of the pet chickens the children could not eat.

blocks.x: No, my mother was living over there and he, he met her, her over there. See, she was living over there with her father. You see my mother's, my mother, mother, which would be my grandmother, she died when my mother was a very young girl, you know. And so her dad married another lady named Miss Henrietta. Okay. And, well she had a stepmother, you know, and he's living across the river, you know, in McDonoughville, you know. Because when I was small, we used to, she took us over there a few times and my dad, my grandfather was over six foot, real dog man, you know, real built, you know. And he had a lot of chickens and, and things in the yard, you know. And he gave all us a little bit of chicken that we raised, you know. He had a yard full of them, you know. And we took them all, brought them all home and raised them and got attached to them, you know. And I remember the time when we didn't have nothing to eat, you know, the chickens that got grown, you know. And saying, you know. We didn't have anything to eat. And my mother went and killed one of those chickens and had them there sitting on the table, you know. And we had been playing, we had been playing with the chickens, give them nams and all, you know. Big Ben and all that. And we sitting there with the chickens there and none of us, we was hungry but we were going to eat it, you know. My mama said, why y'all not eating, you know. And we just couldn't eat them because we had been playing with them. We looked like they got part of us. You see like a seed got a chicken from the store or something, it might have been different.
Yeah. But we said, my brother said, man, why y'all not eating? I said, man, you go, I don't want to eat him. And we was hungry, you know.
